spec.title: PillCheck
spec.subtitle: What the official labels say about the medicines you take together. English, Tamil, Hindi.
spec.closing: Code decides. The model explains. A person decides the dose.

scenes.title: Two medicines, one warning
scenes.caption: Code finds the pair in the FDA label and quotes it; the model explains it plainly.
scenes.input: I take warfarin for my heart. Can I also take Ecosprin that my neighbour gave me?
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "I take warfarin for my heart. Can I also take Ecosprin that my neighbour gave me?"

The labels warn that taking aspirin together with warfarin can increase the risk of bleeding. Aspirin is an antiplatelet agent, and warfarin is an anticoagulant, so using them together may raise the chance of severe stomach bleeding or other bleeding problems.
